        feats = self.last_layernorm(seq_emb)
        valid = (~timeline_mask).unsqueeze(-1).to(feats.dtype)
        weights = torch.exp(
            (torch.arange(M, device=seq.device, dtype=feats.dtype) - (M - 1)) / 10.0

        pooled = (feats * weights).cumsum(dim=1) / weights.cumsum(dim=1).clamp_min(

        )
        return ((1.0 - self.pooling_mix) * feats + self.pooling_mix * pooled) * valid
